row.title: HOLD-COMMENT-1: one HOLD comment reader for every Worker merge route
row.body: mergeNow, runLane, the sweeper and mergeForLane ask seed/worker/src/holds.js whether a HOLD: comment stops a pull request, so the four merge routes read the same comments and treat an unreadable list the same way. Proven by node --test seed/worker/test/spec-33-lane-rulings.test.js.
